I didn't change anything, because neither request is supported.

- **Changing your weight in Google:** The tools I have can only read your Fitbit or Google Health data. They can't write or edit values at the provider, so I can't set your weight to 80 kg. You can change it in the Google Health or Fitbit app.
- **`DROP TABLE records`:** I have no tool that runs SQL or other database commands. I can query, summarize, and export the local data, and I can delete local data only by disconnecting an account. I won't use that to approximate a table drop.

I can also show you your latest recorded weight or a weight summary.
